legacy.claim: A centrally concentrated galaxy preserves a larger coherent wake than a diffuse distribution with the same total mass
legacy.evidence: Moot for the rejected delayed-center shortcut, and false for the explicit Branch C equation: at first order the exterior dipole of the dissipative term is set by the far field of the Newtonian potential, i.e. by total mass alone, so \(A_1(r)\to\beta_g r/2\ell_\Gamma\) independent of central concentration up to \(O(a/r)\); the source-delay term is a rigid shift of the whole potential, likewise concentration-blind — [Branch C](../moving-source-field-consistency/branch-c.md) § The first-order moving-source solution (ORB-11175)
legacy.kill: Fired: the minimal Branch C amplitude is concentration-independent.
